column1: Flatpak: first-time setup + install an app from Flathub?
column2:
sudo pacman -S --needed flatpak
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
flatpak install flathub <app-id>     # e.g. org.vinegarhq.Sober
flatpak run <app-id>                  # launch from terminal

column1: Flatpak: update apps -- and why isn't `pacman -Syu` enough?
column2:
flatpak update              # all flatpak apps + runtimes
flatpak update <app-id>     # just one

Flatpak is a SEPARATE package system from pacman. `pacman -Syu` never touches
flatpaks and vice versa -- keep the system current with BOTH.

column1: Just installed my first flatpak but it's not in the app menu -- why, and the fix?
column2:
Until the session restarts, XDG_DATA_DIRS doesn't include flatpak's exports
dir, so flatpak apps don't show in the launcher (flatpak warns about this).
Fix: log out and back in (or reboot). Meanwhile run it with:
  flatpak run <app-id>

column1: Flatpak: list what's installed, check an app's version, clean up unused runtimes?
column2:
flatpak list                 # installed apps + runtimes
flatpak info <app-id>        # version / branch / commit / date
flatpak uninstall <app-id>
flatpak uninstall --unused   # remove runtimes nothing needs

column1: Roblox on Linux -- the maintained method, and the one caveat?
column2:
Sober (a Flatpak, runs the Android Roblox client):
  flatpak install flathub org.vinegarhq.Sober
No native client; skip Grapejuice (old, deprecated Wine method).

Caveat: Roblox is unofficial on Linux -- its anti-cheat (Hyperion) can break
the client after a Roblox update until Sober patches it. If it won't launch:
`flatpak update`, then check github.com/vinegarhq/sober releases/issues.
